definition:
### Symbol reference

| Symbol | Meaning | Bound | Shell variable |
|:-------|:--------|:------|:---------------|
| $\lambda$ | arrival rate | $\lambda < \mu$ | `$ARRIVAL_RATE` |
| $\mu$ | service rate | $\mu > 0$ | `$SERVICE_RATE` |
| $\rho$ | utilisation | $\rho = \lambda/\mu$ | `$UTILISATION` |
| $W$ | waiting time | $W = 1/(\mu-\lambda)$ | `$WAIT_SECONDS` |

Environment variables are read verbatim by the harness.
